title: Web: Setup, Context notes
description: GET /api/coach/setup/context-notes. Every context note, newest first (by applies_from). POST /api/coach/setup/context-notes/add {text, applies_from, applies_to?, tags, suggest_unusable? ('no' by default), exercise_id?} runs chat's add_context_note with `text` as the user's words; POST /api/coach/setup/context-notes/delete {id} runs chat's delete_context_note. Both return this view.

tag_options.description: Every tag a note can carry (context_note.schema.json).
